text.about:
In 2026, the Legislature appropriated $35 million in one-time funds to the Chancellor’s Office to support colleges as they build the capacity to offer, award, and transcribe credit for prior learning (CPL) leading to completion and career attainment. This site details the allocation of funds based on per-program current and potential outcomes in compliance with §78093.2(d), which states:

(d)(1) Upon appropriation by the Legislature for purposes of this article, the chancellor’s office shall allocate designated funds to support implementation of this article at each campus using all of the following goals:
(A) Increasing access to credit for prior learning opportunities equitably for all eligible students.
(B) Increasing completion through credit for prior learning awards.
(C) Advancing career attainment through credit for prior learning.
(D) Supporting credit for prior learning opportunities through the chancellor’s office’s pilot projects, such as the California Mapping Articulated Pathways Initiative.

(d)(2) Each campus shall demonstrate that it has implemented the credit for prior learning initiative established pursuant to this article through the metrics described in paragraph (1) before receiving an allocation of funding for purposes of implementing this article.

The model measures outcomes in equivalent FTES based on CPL units and allocates funding to institutions proportionally for each priority at an FTES reimbursement rate. Minimum (base) and maximum (cap) funding ensure sustainable support for every participant. The model relies on data in the MAP platform, which serves as the Chancellor’s Office systemwide CPL infrastructure.

extraReqs: Minimum of 75% of enrolled veteran Joint Services Transcripts uploaded in MAP and processed for CPL
Scenario 1.coordLabel: CPL Coordinator assigned and primary CPL contact listed in MAP and the college public CPL Landing Page configured.

strategies: Get noncredit certificates and industry-aligned courses into MAP as exhibits, so a credit college can adopt them rather than re-evaluate them
Build mirror-course or noncredit-to-credit articulation with your feeder college for your highest-volume programs
Route apprenticeship and pre-apprenticeship completers to CPL review before they enroll
Put named articulation agreements in place: which noncredit completion maps to which credit course
Hand the completer to a person at the receiving college, not to a webpage
Track completers through to transcription at the receiving college, and report back what did not transcribe
Stand up a noncredit CPL landing page with its own MAP location ID, so credit your students earn traces back to your program
Add a CPL step at the end of every noncredit certificate: ask each completer what prior learning they hold and where they intend to enroll
Name, on your landing page, the credit colleges that already accept your training

0.title: Access
0.metric: Applied CPL Units (FTES) originating from either CPL Portal, College CPL Landing Page, or batch upload
strategies: Adopt, adapt, create credit recommendations for current and prospective students
Find your top 15 ACE credit recommendations for enrolled veterans and route them to faculty for articulation and award
Create high-school articulated course exhibits in MAP and batch upload previous two year's of awarded students to MAP
Develop procedures to obtain and batch upload CCCApply authorized JSTs for every enrolled military student and award credit
List CPL on program pathway maps, flyers, and the program review process and link from your College CPL Landing Page
Process all CPL petitions and requests from the College CPL Landing Page, ensuring that essential outcomes data is credited
Convene a CPL strike team to work the requests, opportunities, and any backlog--use CPL funding to support reassign time, special projects, overtime, workgroups, etc.
Configure your College CPL Landing Page, including a CPL Request Email, and link or embed it on the college website
0.description: Adopt local or statewide articulations and process CPL petitions through requests originating from college CPL Landing Pages, the Student Portal, and batch upload.

1.title: Completion with Transcription
1.metric: Transcribed CPL Units measured in FTES
strategies: Batch upload all transcribed CPL from academic year 2023 to date, including high-school articulated Cx grades
Include AP, IB, CLEP, high-school articulated credit by exam, noncredit mirror courses, basic training credit, and elective and GE Area CPL previously waived but never transcribed
Complete the Transcribe step in MAP for every student record carrying CPL
Match SIS transcribed CPL to MAP records to close data gaps and ensure correct MIS reporting
Support Admissions and Records and Veterans Resource Center staff in CPL work
Screen near-completers for CPL that would finish their award
1.description: Institutionalize college procedures to note transcribed CPL in MAP to later reconcile with MIS.

2.title: Completion
2.metric: Transcribed CPL units (FTES) for students  with Counselor step checked
strategies: Process all CPL petitions and requests from the College CPL Landing Page or CPL Portal, ensuring that essential outcomes data is credited
Assign a CPL Strike Team: a named CPL Coordinator and Counselor, listed in MAP and responsive to College CPL Landing Page and CPL Portal petitions.
Make CPL screening part of student onboarding and ed planning process (Ed. Code 78093.2(b)(1)).
Act on all JST credit recommendations for enrolled service members and award course credit for Basic Training

Batch upload CPL recipients to MAP from Fall 2024 onward and ensure that the Counselor and Transcribed steps are checked provided they met with a counselor. Include AP, IB, CLEP, high-school articulated credit by exam, noncredit mirror courses, basic training credit, and elective and GE Area CPL previously waived but never transcribed.
Review your CPL Administrative Procedure and remove barriers to access and completion
Rely on CreditforBeingYou.org to serve as your automated CPL screening and petition procedure.
2.description: Screen all incoming students for potential CPL, apply all beneficial credit to student education plan, and accurately transcribe upon acceptance of credit

strategies: Screen near-completers for CPL that would finish their award
Ensure that all student records in MAP include a valid Student ID, First and Last Names, and Date of Birth to support matching records with MIS and EDD wage records.
Add Career Attainment goal for student on CPL Petition
Add student CPL completion and career stories on MAP at: https://map.rccd.edu/cplstories/
